faqs.question: How do I call a business or doctor?
faqs.answer: Simply tap the Call button on any card or detail screen. Your phone dialer will open with the number pre-filled.

faqs.question: How do I get directions to a clinic or store?
faqs.answer: Tap "Directions" on the detail page or "Open in Google Maps" on the Location screen to view turn-by-turn routing.

faqs.question: How do I filter businesses by rating or city?
faqs.answer: Use the filter chips at the top of the search and listing screens or tap the filter sliders icon to open all filter options.

faqs.question: How do I switch between Dark and Light themes?
faqs.answer: Go to your Profile tab and toggle the theme switch. BizFinder will remember your selection permanently.
